review:
The Big Bass formula at a beach bar. Three to five scatters give 10 to 20 free spins, and up to five modifiers can be added first – more money symbols, more wilds, extra spins or starting at level two.

In free spins, wilds collect money symbols worth up to 5,000x, and every fourth wild adds 10 spins with a bigger multiplier: 2x, then 3x, then 10x. 96.5% RTP. Great if you love Big Bass but want a different look.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
